name: Refuse unsafe external managed-state namespace before mutation

files_create.purpose: Independent Test Engineer real public allocation/admission/reconcile negative and positive namespace controls.
Cooperative namespace safety and precise hostile-sameUID-race exclusion.
Exact selected namespace guard and acceptance controls.

files_modify.purpose: Nofollow managed-directory and opened regular lock guard before cleanup/write; anchored staging cleanup.
One exact offline corpus command in existing fixtures job; no runner/permissions/check identity change.

non_goals: No installed .nizam mutation, production/live/paid operation or release
No hostile sameUID concurrent rename guarantee
No new ledger, recovery authority, capture policy or retry budget change
acceptance_requirements: Before creating missing managed directories, opening/creating state.lock, staging cleanup or writing state, validate every existing fixed namespace component beneath canonical repo_root: .agent, evidence, external_admissions, permits and admitted. Refuse symlink or non-directory components without deleting or modifying any existing owned/outside files or ledgers. Preflight all existing components before any namespace creation; missing safe components may then be created.

Open the validated root and fixed child directories using directory descriptors with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW and actual fstat directory checks; create missing components relative to validated parent descriptors. Unsupported nofollow primitives fail closed. No chmod/owner repair and no namespace relocation.

Open state.lock relative to anchored state directory with O_NOFOLLOW, O_NONBLOCK, O_CLOEXEC and existing create/readwrite semantics; require actual opened fstat regular file before flock. Existing symlink, FIFO, directory and other nonregular lock must refuse promptly without touching target bytes or running cleanup. Preserve common task-lock ordering.

Validate existing permits/admitted directories before lockfile creation or cleanup; stage cleanup enumerates and unlinks only regular .tmp-* entries relative to anchored validated directory descriptors. Unknown symlink/nonregular .tmp-* entries are preserved and refused; do not follow them or reinterpret as published state. Existing valid regular staging recovery remains supported.

Apply the same guard through allocation, generic admission, typed admission via existing generic core, and reconciliation; public domain exceptions must be controlled, not raw OSError or hangs. Existing authenticated admission/replay, unknown/orphan preservation, counter accounting and wire/API/schema behavior remain unchanged.

Independent actual accepted-source reproduction must retain outside owned .tmp sentinel bytes/mode for whole-state and managed-subdirectory symlinks, existing ancestor symlinks, and state.lock symlink/nonregular cases. Snapshot complete outside tree and ledger/permit/admission counts before and after refusals; positive real regular allocation/admit/replay/reconcile and staging cleanup must pass.

This is a cooperative host managed-namespace guard against unsafe preexisting components. It does not claim protection from hostile sameUID concurrent directory renames after validation; existing path-based publication is retained. No new ledger/controller/history conversion/authority or broad artifact-symlink permission.

Existing ledger.json must be regular in full preflight before namespace creation/lock/cleanup. Actual readonly nofollow/nonblocking opened descriptor must be regular before bytes. Only absent ledger initializes; no history conversion, guessed outcomes or extra authority.
